name: Font Size
what_it_does: Sets the point size of the selected text; the box opens a size list.
behavior: Opens subfeature:font-size (dropdown). Contents (18 controls): Font Size, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 36, 48. [the subfeature:font-size flyout — items are endpoints; swatches pixel-sampled DYNAMIC: scrollable size list — enumerated items are the visible window.] Appears as the point-size box showing the current size (e.g. 12).

connections.why: all set the selection's font or size
